plan.title: Counter offer remains pending during evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen as required for this case.
Ensure counter offers are available on RFQ rounds.
Ensure the RFQ project flow is enabled.
Open the comparison grid containing Vendor A's own bid before raising the counter offer.
Send the closest expressible buyer counter offer against Vendor A's bid.
Verify Procol marks the counter offer as initiated for Vendor A.
View the offer from Vendor A's supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event overview where a pending counter offer is visible.
Verify the vendor sees the pending offer and leave it unanswered.
Open the vendor pricing round to test that revision is unavailable while the counter offer is pending.
Attempt a vendor revision and require Procol to refuse it.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Return to the buyer comparison grid after the vendor has not accepted the offer.
Verify the displayed current price arithmetic remains internally consistent after the pending counter offer.
